what: The opt-in checks from the survey of 2026-11-11 (CORE-IMPROVEMENTS.md items 25-30). A build listed under a check takes it; "*" means every build. New builds list themselves here (README.md, "Starting a new build"); the next all-builds ride-along pass sets every list to "*" (TODO.md, "switch on checks 22-31 everywhere"). KRATOR_CHECKS=all (or a comma list of names) turns them on for one run. tools/buildlib.py opted_in() reads this file.

recorded.what: a plain `python3 build.py` refuses to run unless under tools/build.py (which writes build-inputs.json), and refuses the Git LFS pointers it would read (item 23); tools/check_port.py, which every build.py runs first, enforces it

minset.what: a page that holds core/biome/10-core-head.js holds every fragment of CORE_BIOME_MIN (tools/check_assembly.py, rule MINSET)

samplers.what: the universal assert `samplers`: every linked program's active sampler count, fail at 16, warn at 15 (tools/harness.py verify_page)

drawn-ground.what: the eye check measures the eye against the drawn ground (core/drawn, KDRAWN.h), not only by rays (tools/harness.py verify_page)

names.what: tools/build.py fails a build whose view names hold an apostrophe or a colon (tools/check_views.py, rule VIEW-NAME)
